g.text: Task path: continuous score → code / action → protected release — evaluation
All available registered path settings; fixed lexical horizontal offsets separate configurations. Continuous score repeats across code panels.
No fixed decoder is imputed for a raw code. Hollow markers: 33 actions; black outlines: finer conditioning.
Equal three-anchor means; descriptive comparison, not a causal decomposition or a full-grid inference test.
